sourcePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production character animation atlas for the existing Football Headquarters facility interiors.
Reference image 1 is the exact environment style and camera reference; image 2 is the existing offensive lineman design to reinterpret as an indoor practice athlete. Do not redraw the room.
Create ONE transparent-background sprite atlas, 2048 by 1536 pixels, precisely 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows (each cell 512 by 512). No cell borders, no text, no checkerboard, no floor, no room, no scenery. Every cell holds one complete adult male football athlete; feet and equipment fully inside its cell, consistent scale, baseline and camera. True alpha transparency around figures.
Match the polished painted game rendering of the reference gym: clean fine edges, softly modeled volumes, warm overhead light from upper left, restrained dark outlines, realistic fabric texture and shoe detail. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down around 25 degrees, showing shoulders and tops of shoes. Human adult proportions about 5.5 heads tall, grounded substantial bodies, not tiny cartoon children and not the flat comic shading of reference 2.
Four columns represent stable character identities: column1 a broad heavy light-skinned offensive lineman with short dark hair, column2 a lean athletic Black skill-position player with close-cropped hair, column3 a muscular brown-skinned defensive lineman with short hair, column4 a wiry tan-skinned defensive back with short hair. Each identity, clothes, body proportions, lighting, camera and foot positions remain EXACTLY the same down its column.
All wear fitted cool navy-blue short-sleeved practice shirts, charcoal athletic shorts and socks, neutral gray trainers. No helmet, pads, football, jersey numbers, lettering, badges or colored accessories. Navy shirt is the sole cool-blue material, ready for game palette tinting; skin stays warm.
Row1: relaxed standing ready for a scouting meeting, empty hands at sides, feet comfortably planted, looking three-quarter toward camera.
Row2: lifting start, one dark neutral steel dumbbell in each hand, elbows beside torso, dumbbells held low beside hips. Feet identically planted.
Row3: lifting peak, the same dumbbells curled toward shoulders with elbows beside torso; do not move torso or feet relative to row2. This is a two-frame controlled curl, not a jump or running pose.
Consistent figure size and aligned foot baselines across all 12 cells. Leave at least 36 pixels transparent padding at every cell edge. No baked shadow, no glow, no watermark. Professional game assets which belong inside reference1 rather than pasted sports stickers.
finalMatteEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied 12-player character atlas. Preserve the four identities, navy practice shirts, charcoal shorts, neutral shoes, warm overhead light, elevated camera, and three poses per identity. Replace every bit of the checkerboard with ONE FLAT PURE MAGENTA (#ff00ff) background, with NO texture, gradient or shadows; this is a chroma-key source for the game's renderer. Do not introduce magenta into any character. Make all twelve complete figures smaller so there is ample magenta space around each. Re-layout as an exact 4-column by 3-row grid on a 2048 by 1536 canvas; each 512-square cell has its athlete centered, with at least 48 pixels of clear magenta on all four edges. Entire shoes and dumbbells must be visible. The first row is empty-handed standing; second row dumbbells low; third row dumbbells curled. Same identity down each column. All figures approximately 400 pixels tall, feet on y=448 within each cell. No checkerboard, no borders, no captions, no lettering. Change only background and layout/scale; retain the approved character artwork.
note: Generated atlas is an opaque magenta production matte. Runtime canvas compositing keys the matte; no generated checkerboard ships. Four position-group identities, three authored poses each. Existing rooms preserved.
